assumption_ablation.Born: No computation can validate a factorized system-bath state from the reduced equation; weak coupling is indispensable to the stated derivation.
assumption_ablation.Markov: Finite correlation produces a nonexponential initial slip; maximum mismatch grows with tau_B Gamma.
assumption_ablation.Secular: For longitudinal sigma_z coupling [H_S,sigma_z]=0, no +/-2 omega_q transverse terms occur; secular removal does not alter this pure-dephasing algebra, but it is relevant to mixed/transverse alternatives.
assumption_ablation.Stationary bath: Without time-translation-invariant C_JJ, the integral used to define a constant rate is not justified.
assumption_ablation.single_exponential_correlation: The integral rate can remain defined, but the finite-time envelope need not be the single exponential used by the Markov reduction.

verdict: The quadratic Markov rate is not established outside its small tau_B Gamma region; this is a derivational limitation, not a numerical failure.
